answer: Before payout, any peer may contest a relic in the willow escrow by staking 100,000 POA. Each identity deposits one relic at registration, backed by a 400,000 POA bond, and the escrow burns an ember mark into it: if two relics share one ember mark, both are voided — the operator loses the bond per fake and pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake, and the rewards pass to honest peers. Five fakes therefore cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
